title: The Emergency Call Problem
narration: If a foreign army crossed your border tonight... who would you call? The UN? Think again.

title: The Brutal Reality of Anarchy
narration: In world politics, there is no global 911. Realists call this brutal reality: Anarchy. Not chaos, but the total absence of a supreme authority.

title: The Three S's of Realism
narration: Because no one is coming to save you, states survive by three ruthless rules: Statism, Survival, and Self-Help.

title: Ruthless Logic of Survival
narration: Statism: states are the only players that matter. Survival: avoiding extinction at all costs. And Self-Help: trust no one, build your military, and assume the worst.

title: The Security Dilemma Paradox
narration: When every nation arms itself to feel safe, the whole world becomes infinitely more dangerous. That is the Security Dilemma.

title: The Cold Reality of Power
narration: Welcome to Political Realism. Can world peace ever truly exist? Drop your thoughts below.
